name: rolling-letters-animation
title: Rolling Letters Animation
description: 移植自 MosaicUI，MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Darshan Sunil Rajadhyaksha。 https://github.com/darshan-rajadhyaksha/mosaicui/blob/2baca92/src/registry/text-effects/rolling-letters-animation/rolling-letters-animation.tsx 每个字母在一条短卷轴里滚到目标字符。偶数位向上揭开，奇数位向下揭开。卷轴按序号播种。减弱动效停在终态。离开视口时连续动画暂停，回到视口再继续。
